## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Claiming a Claude-archetype dispatch from the queue starts a claude...

The system SHALL ensure that claiming a Claude-archetype dispatch from the queue starts a claude remote-control session in a fresh managed worktree that appears in the Claude app session list and records sub-agent phase dispatch rather than phase_fallback_inline.

#### Scenario: Claiming a Claude-archetype dispatch from the queue starts a claude...

WHEN `build-the-queue-backed-gx10-launcher-for-claude-codex-and-ge` is implemented
THEN Claiming a Claude-archetype dispatch from the queue starts a claude remote-control session in a fresh managed worktree that appears in the Claude app session list and records sub-agent phase dispatch rather than phase_fallback_inline.

### Requirement: Claiming a dispatch whose archetype names Codex as primary implementer...

The system SHALL ensure that claiming a dispatch whose archetype names Codex as primary implementer starts a codex exec worker in a managed worktree that returns a schema-valid dispatch result.

#### Scenario: Claiming a dispatch whose archetype names Codex as primary implementer...

WHEN `build-the-queue-backed-gx10-launcher-for-claude-codex-and-ge` is implemented
THEN Claiming a dispatch whose archetype names Codex as primary implementer starts a codex exec worker in a managed worktree that returns a schema-valid dispatch result.

### Requirement: A dispatch with an invalid signature or for a repository not on the...

The system SHALL ensure that a dispatch with an invalid signature or for a repository not on the allowlist is refused and logged with no process started, and no worker receives a permission mode beyond its archetype's declared mode.

#### Scenario: A dispatch with an invalid signature or for a repository not on the...

WHEN `build-the-queue-backed-gx10-launcher-for-claude-codex-and-ge` is implemented
THEN A dispatch with an invalid signature or for a repository not on the allowlist is refused and logged with no process started, and no worker receives a permission mode beyond its archetype's declared mode.

### Requirement: After a launcher restart, in-flight workers are re-adopted or their...

The system SHALL ensure that after a launcher restart, in-flight workers are re-adopted or their dispatches requeued using only coordinator, worktree, and loop-state records.

#### Scenario: After a launcher restart, in-flight workers are re-adopted or their...

WHEN `build-the-queue-backed-gx10-launcher-for-claude-codex-and-ge` is implemented
THEN After a launcher restart, in-flight workers are re-adopted or their dispatches requeued using only coordinator, worktree, and loop-state records.

### Requirement: Decision cards and digests produced for launcher-run dispatches are written...

The system SHALL ensure that decision cards and digests produced for launcher-run dispatches are written by a GX10 local model, and the usage ledger shows zero subscription tokens spent on them.

#### Scenario: Decision cards and digests produced for launcher-run dispatches are written...

WHEN `build-the-queue-backed-gx10-launcher-for-claude-codex-and-ge` is implemented
THEN Decision cards and digests produced for launcher-run dispatches are written by a GX10 local model, and the usage ledger shows zero subscription tokens spent on them.
